question: Chulia waterfall is situated on Chambal River in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Chulia waterfall on the Chambal river in **Chittorgarh district of Rajasthan.**
 
• The Chuliya water is 5 km upstream of the Chambal river near Bhainsrorgarh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
